In the Donut SMP store, players can purchase the Donut+ rank: an in-game title that lasts 30 days per payment. The rank's perks include:

* 9  homes using the "/home" command.
* The access to the "/hide" command (which scrambles your username)
* Shards without needing to be in an AFK area. You still need to be online to get the shards though (obviously)
* A special mark in front of your username
* Fast auction purchasing
* Nearer the front of the server tab list
* 45 ah slots
* 45 order slots
Donut++ is like Donut+ but with extra perks:

* 27 homes
* 90 ah slots
* 90 order slots

Donut+++ is like Donut++ but with extra perks:

* 90 homes 
* Priority chunk generation

If you unsubscribe from the rank, the homes wont suddenly disappear; instead, you wont be able to set new ones until you resubscribe.

Right now, DrDonut is banning players he suspects are AFKing bots, so even if you get Donut+ for a bot to AFK shards and spawners/farms at the same time. To avoid getting banned, it's reccomended to play on those accounts.

Right now, people can now buy Donut++ and Donut+++ in the [https://store.donutsmp.net/store DonutSMP] store.
